title: 100 Objects #23: Coin From the Ship of Gold

sentences.en: It's August 20th, 1857 in the port of San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 那是1857年8月20日，在旧金山港口。

sentences.en: And this particular day is called Steamer Day because there's this massive steamship tied to the dock that has a gangway where passengers are loading on.
sentences.zh: 这一天被称为“轮船日”，因为有一艘巨大的轮船系在码头上，船上有个舷梯，乘客们正在登船。

sentences.en: People are saying goodbye.
sentences.zh: 人们在道别。

sentences.en: I sort of picture it like the opening scene of Titanic.
sentences.zh: 我脑海中的画面有点像《泰坦尼克号》的开场。

sentences.en: Yeah, that makes sense.
sentences.zh: 对，这很好理解。

sentences.en: Everyone is so excited.
sentences.zh: 每个人都兴奋极了。

sentences.en: They're getting on the ship.
sentences.zh: 他们正在上船。

sentences.en: They're saying goodbye to their loved ones.
sentences.zh: 他们在跟挚爱之人告别。

sentences.en: And there are these first class passengers.
sentences.zh: 还有一些头等舱乘客。

sentences.en: So among them is this newlywed couple.
sentences.zh: 他们当中有一对新婚夫妇。

sentences.en: Their names are Ansel and Adeline Easton.
sentences.zh: 他们叫安塞尔和阿德琳·伊斯顿。

sentences.en: They have literally just gotten married.
sentences.zh: 他们真的才刚结婚。

sentences.en: So Adeline is still in her wedding dress.
sentences.zh: 所以阿德琳还穿着她的婚纱。

sentences.en: They've gotten married in the city.
sentences.zh: 他们在城里结了婚。

sentences.en: They wound their way to the port.
sentences.zh: 一路辗转来到港口。

sentences.en: And now they're getting on the ship for their honeymoon.
sentences.zh: 现在他们要登船去度蜜月了。

sentences.en: And then there are the standard passengers who are going to be sleeping in what's called steerage,
sentences.zh: 然后还有普通舱乘客，他们将睡在所谓的统舱里，

sentences.en: where you sleep in the belly of the ship in hammocks that are stacked on top of each other.
sentences.zh: 就是睡在船舱底部的吊床里，一个叠一个那种。

sentences.en: And most of these people in steerage are miners because it's 1857.
sentences.zh: 统舱里的大多数人都是矿工，因为当时是1857年。

sentences.en: So we are several years into the California gold rush.
sentences.zh: 所以加州淘金热已经持续了好几年。

sentences.en: And this is miners with an ER, not an OR.
sentences.zh: 这里的矿工指的是“miners”，而不是“minors”（未成年人）。

sentences.en: Like these are children.
sentences.zh: 就像这些不是小孩子。

sentences.en: These are men.
sentences.zh: 这些是成年男子。

sentences.en: These are miners with an ER.
sentences.zh: 这些是从事采矿的矿工。

sentences.en: These are adult miners, the sort of classic 49ers who have made their way to the California gold rush across the country,
sentences.zh: 这些是成年矿工，也就是那种横跨整个国家赶赴加州淘金热的经典“四九淘金者”，

sentences.en: have hopefully amassed a small fortune and are going to be taking this ship back east to live off the gold that they've mined.
sentences.zh: 他们希望已经攒下了一小笔财富，并打算乘这艘船回东部，靠挖出来的黄金生活。

sentences.en: A lot of them are carrying the gold like literally on their body.
sentences.zh: 他们中的很多人把黄金直接带在身上。

sentences.en: You know, there's a real fear of like, you don't want to be robbed.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，大家真的很怕被抢。

sentences.en: You don't want it stolen from you.
sentences.zh: 谁都不想被偷。

sentences.en: But also like, I didn't realize this, that gold is so heavy.
sentences.zh: 而且还有一点我之前没意识到，黄金太重了。

sentences.en: It is so dense that like a regular house brick, like a red brick, weighs like four pounds, right?
sentences.zh: 它密度极高，比如一块普通的红砖大概重四磅，对吧？

sentences.en: The same size brick that's gold weighs 43 pounds.
sentences.zh: 同样大小的纯金砖重达43磅。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I didn't realize it was that heavy either.
sentences.zh: 我之前也不知道它有这么重。

sentences.en: It's so heavy.
sentences.zh: 太重了。

sentences.en: So they're carrying like 50 pounds of gold, money belts and purses.
sentences.zh: 所以他们身上带着大概50磅重的黄金、钱带和钱包。

sentences.en: They're keeping it close to them.
sentences.zh: 他们把它紧紧贴身收好。

sentences.en: It's basically all they have.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是他们的全部家当了。

sentences.en: You know, I got so many of these details from the guy on this topic.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，关于这个话题的很多细节，我是从一个研究它的专家那里了解到的。

sentences.en: This guy's name is Gary Kinder.
sentences.zh: 这个人叫加里·金德。

sentences.en: He spent decades researching the journey that this ship is going to take.
sentences.zh: 他花了数十年时间研究这艘船即将经历的航程。

sentences.en: And who are you?
sentences.zh: 那你又是谁？

sentences.en: And who am I?
sentences.zh: 我又す是谁？

sentences.en: I'm your editor, usually.
sentences.zh: 我通常是你的剪辑师。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: My name is Annie Brown.
sentences.zh: 我叫安妮·布朗。

sentences.en: I normally edit the show, but I came across this story right at the beginning.
sentences.zh: 我平时负责这个节目的剪辑，但在刚开始考虑“100件物品项目”的时候，我偶然发现了这个故事。

sentences.en: Of starting to think about the 100 Objects Project.
sentences.zh: 开始构思“100件物品项目”的时候。

sentences.en: And I became so obsessed with it that I've had a really hard time giving it to anybody else.
sentences.zh: 我对它着迷不已，以至于实在舍不得把它交给别人来讲。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It's been kind of fun.
sentences.zh: 这其实挺有意思的。

sentences.en: We've been thinking about like assigning it to people.
sentences.zh: 我们之前一直在考虑把它分配给其他人来讲。

sentences.en: And you were like, I know this story backwards and forwards.
sentences.zh: 而你当时说：我对这个故事的里里外外了如指掌。

sentences.en: Maybe I should just tell it.
sentences.zh: 也许应该由我来亲自讲述。

sentences.en: I'm going to tell it.
sentences.zh: 我要自己讲这个故事。

sentences.en: That is executive producer privilege right there.
sentences.zh: 这就是执行制片人的特权啊。

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: And here I am doing it.
sentences.zh: 这不，我这就在讲了。

sentences.en: Okay, back to the San Francisco port late in the summer of 1857, where 600 people are boarding this steamer and something else is being loaded onto the ship.
sentences.zh: 好，言归正传，回到1857年夏末的旧金山港口，600人正在登上这艘轮船，同时装船的还有其他东西。

sentences.en: Thousands of pounds of gold pressed into bars and coins destined for the vaults of New York City banks.
sentences.zh: 数千磅压制成金条和金币的黄金，它们的目的地是纽约市各大银行的金库。

sentences.en: The gold rush has completely revolutionized the American economy.
sentences.zh: 淘金热彻底彻底彻底革新了美国经济。

sentences.en: But at this point in 1857, we're about like eight or nine years into the gold rush.
sentences.zh: 但到了1857年这个时候，淘金热已经持续了大约八九年。

sentences.en: It is tapering off.
sentences.zh: 热度正在逐渐消退。

sentences.en: And the banks in New York really need an influx of gold to shore up their coffers.
sentences.zh: 纽约的银行确实需要黄金的大量涌入来巩固他们的资金库。

sentences.en: There's a sense that like the economy is overheating.
sentences.zh: 当时有一种感觉，就是经济过热了。

sentences.en: We don't have as much gold as we thought we were going to have.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有的黄金没有想象中那么多。

sentences.en: In all, the ship is carrying around three tons of gold, which today would be worth about $400 million.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，这艘船载着大约三吨黄金，按今天的价值计算约为4亿美元。

sentences.en: Significant, for sure.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是个天文数字。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a lot of gold.
sentences.zh: 对，黄金非常多。

sentences.en: It gets loaded up.
sentences.zh: 黄金装好之后。

sentences.en: It takes off.
sentences.zh: 船就出发了。

sentences.en: It follows this route down to Panama.
sentences.zh: 它沿着这条路线一路南下到巴拿马。

sentences.en: All the passengers are going to take their gold.
sentences.zh: 所有的乘客都要带着他们的黄金。

sentences.en: They're going to cross the Isthmus and they're going to get on a different ship on the other side of Panama that's going to take them back to New York.
sentences.zh: 他们要穿过地峡，然后在巴拿马的另一侧登上另一艘船，乘船返回纽约。

sentences.en: Because this is before the Panama Canal.
sentences.zh: 因为当时还没有巴拿马运河。

sentences.en: So you actually have to...
sentences.zh: 所以你实际上必须……

sentences.en: It's before the Panama Canal, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，是在巴拿马运河修建之前。

sentences.en: So you have to take a boat and you have to walk over Panama, which is the narrowest point.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须坐船，然后步行穿过巴拿马，那是两地之间最短的路线。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: At this point, there is a rail, but there is no way for a ship to cross.
sentences.zh: 当时虽然有铁路，但还没有供船只通行的运河。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They cross with all their belongings and all of this gold across the Isthmus.
sentences.zh: 他们带着所有的随身物品和这些黄金穿过了地峡。

sentences.en: They get on another ship on the other side.
sentences.zh: 在另一侧登上另一艘船。

sentences.en: And that ship is going to take them and the gold to New York.
sentences.zh: 那艘船将载着他们和黄金去纽约。

sentences.en: But that ship never makes it to New York.
sentences.zh: 但那艘船从未抵达纽约。

sentences.en: And when it sinks, it takes all of that gold with it.
sentences.zh: 当它沉没时，所有的黄金也随之沉入海底。

sentences.en: And it sparks the first global financial panic the world has ever seen.
sentences.zh: 这也引发了世界历史上第一次全球金融恐慌。

sentences.en: And for over a century, the gold will just sit on the bottom of the ocean until one man finds it.
sentences.zh: 在长达一个多世纪的时间里，这些黄金一直静静地躺在洋底，直到一个人找到了它。

sentences.en: And the gold that he's going to bring up from the bottom of the ocean, by all accounts, totally ruins his life.
sentences.zh: 而他将从海底捞起的这些黄金，据各方所述，彻底毁了他的一生。

sentences.en: From 99% Invisible and BBC Studios, this is a history of the United States in 100 Objects.
sentences.zh: 来自“99%隐形”与BBC录音室，这里是“100件物品中的美国历史”。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Today, a coin from the ship of gold and how this coin tells the story of the birth of the American economy,
sentences.zh: 今天，我们要讲述一枚来自黄金之船的金币，以及这枚金币如何讲述美国经济诞生、

sentences.en: the rise of global financial panics, and how greed can drive people and a whole country mad.
sentences.zh: 全球金融恐慌兴起的故事，以及贪婪如何让人类乃至整个国家陷入疯狂。

sentences.en: So, the dramatic story of this ship and its sinking, it really starts with the gold rush.
sentences.zh: 所以，这艘船及其沉没的戏剧性故事，其实正是始于淘金热。

sentences.en: So, let's back up and talk about the gold rush a little bit.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们把时间倒回一点，聊聊淘金热。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 行。

sentences.en: So, let's do the origin story of the gold rush.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们从淘金热的起源故事讲起。

sentences.en: Let's do the classic story.
sentences.zh: 讲讲那个经典的故事。

sentences.en: It's January 24th, 1848.
So, that's nine years before steamer day that I've just taken you through.
sentences.zh: 也就是我刚刚带大家了解的“轮船日”的九年前。

sentences.en: We're in Northern California, about 100 miles northeast of San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 我们在北加州，在旧金山东北约100英里处。

sentences.en: It's kind of near present-day Sacramento.
sentences.zh: 大概在现在的萨克拉门托附近。

sentences.en: It's a cold morning.
sentences.zh: 那是一个寒冷的早晨。

sentences.en: A guy named James Marshall wakes up early, and he walks down to the portion of the American River where he's been building a sawmill.
sentences.zh: 一个叫詹姆斯·马歇尔的人起得很早，他走到美洲河他一直在修建锯木厂的那段河域。

sentences.en: He turns off the flow of the water to inspect it, and the water lays there still so he can see down into it,
sentences.zh: 他关掉水流以便进行检查，水面平静下来，他得以看清河底的情况，

sentences.en: and he sees a little yellow lump on a flat rock.
sentences.zh: 然后他在一块平坦的石头上看到了一块黄色的发光小块。

sentences.en: It's the size and shape of his thumbnail.
sentences.zh: 它的大小和形状跟他的大拇指指甲盖差不多。

sentences.en: He says it's shiny, without sparkle, and it sort of looks like a piece of chewed-up spruce gum.
sentences.zh: 他说它亮晶晶的，但没有反光，看起来有点像一块嚼过的云杉树脂口香糖。

sentences.en: He tries to smash it with another rock, then a hammer.
sentences.zh: 他试着用另一块石头去砸它，后来又用了锤子。

sentences.en: It doesn't shatter, but it flattens.
sentences.zh: 它没有碎，而是被压扁了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So, he kind of knows what it is.
sentences.zh: 所以他大概知道这是什么了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: He's like, it's not fool's gold.
sentences.zh: 他心里想，这不是愚人金。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But I sort of imagine he's, like, not quite letting himself get too excited at this point, right?
sentences.zh: 但我猜他当时大概不敢让自己太兴奋，对吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, he rides back through the snow to his boss, this guy John Sutter, who is building what's called Sutter's Fort.
sentences.zh: 于是他冒着雪骑马回去找他的老板，也就是正在修建所谓“萨特堡”的约翰·萨特。

sentences.en: It's kind of like an agriculture and trade colony at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时那地方有点像一个农业和贸易殖民地。

sentences.en: So, he pulls his boss into a locked room because he knows that if what he found is what he thinks he found, it's going to change everything.
sentences.zh: 他把老板拉进一间锁着的屋子里，因为他知道如果自己找到的东西正是他所想的那样，一切都将改变。

sentences.en: So, they unwrap the nugget.
sentences.zh: 于是他们打开包裹金块的东西。

sentences.en: Sutter pulls an old chemistry book off of the shelf, and they try these tests to see if it's actually gold.
sentences.zh: 萨特从书架上拿下一本旧化学书，他们开始做测试，看看这到底是不是黄金。

sentences.en: They pour nitric acid on it.
sentences.zh: 他们把硝酸倒在上面。

sentences.en: I don't know why they had nitric acid in this little room with them.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么他们这间小房子里会备有硝酸。

sentences.en: It's such a strange thing to have.
sentences.zh: 屋里备着这个可真够奇怪的。

sentences.en: But it doesn't change color.
sentences.zh: 但它没有变色。

sentences.en: They weigh it.
sentences.zh: 他们称了重量。

sentences.en: It weighs far more than silver.
sentences.zh: 它的重量比白银重得多。

sentences.en: It's gold.
sentences.zh: 这就是黄金。

sentences.en: This is the real deal.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是真货。

sentences.en: So, people can't help but talk and gossip when it comes to gold and maybe all things, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 所以一提到黄金，人们就忍不住交头接耳、八卦起来，大概对所有事都是如此吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And so, the word gets out, and then it becomes what is the gold rush.
sentences.zh: 消息就这样传开了，然后这就演变成了所谓的淘金热。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, in 1849 alone, 85,000 men and women flock to California.
sentences.zh: 光是在1849年一年里，就有8.5万名男女涌入加州。

sentences.en: So, at the time, there are under 1,000 people living in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 当时，旧金山居住的人口还不到1000人。

sentences.en: And just in 1849 alone, we have 85,000 coming.
sentences.zh: 而仅在1849年这一年，我们就迎来了8.5万人的涌入。

sentences.en: So, these are called the 49ers, right?
sentences.zh: 所以这些人被称为“四九淘金者”，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, this is where we get the term, the 49ers.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们所说的“四九淘金者”这个词的由来。

sentences.en: And California just totally changes in this time.
sentences.zh: 加州也在这一时期彻底发生了改变。

sentences.en: Ships are sailing into the harbor, and every member of every crew would just disappear into the hills.
sentences.zh: 一艘艘船只驶入港口，每一艘船上的每一个船员都会直接跑进山里去。

sentences.en: There was an army stationed there, and they couldn't keep soldiers working with the army.
sentences.zh: 当时驻扎在那里的一支军队，甚至无法留住士兵继续在军队服役。

sentences.en: One soldier explained it in this amazing quote.
sentences.zh: 有个士兵用一段精彩绝伦的话解释了这种心情。

sentences.en: The struggle between right and $6 a month and wrong and $75 a day is a rather severe one.
sentences.zh: 在每月6美元的正义与每天75美元的邪恶之间做抉择，可真是一个相当艰难的决定。

sentences.en: That's a good point.
sentences.zh: 这话在理。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: That, like, you could make in a day what it would take to make in a year.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，你一天就能赚到平时要干一年才能赚到的钱。

sentences.en: Almost a year.
sentences.zh: 几乎是一年。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对啊。

sentences.en: That's crazy.
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So, at this point, there isn't a mint in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 所以，在当时，旧金山还没有铸币厂。

sentences.en: So, you just have raw gold that people are kind of carrying around and taking to assayers that are pressing it into something.
sentences.zh: 因此，你手里只有原金，人们随身携带，然后拿到化验师那里压制成某种东西。

sentences.en: But often, you would pay for stuff with gold duSt.
sentences.zh: 但通常，你会用金砂来买东西。

sentences.en: And there's this incredible fact that Gary told me, that you would go into a saloon after a day mining to get a drink, and you would pay in gold duSt.
sentences.zh: 加里告诉我一个难以置信的事实：淘金一天后，你会去酒吧喝一杯，然后用金砂支付。

sentences.en: And the bartenders would take a pinch of your gold dust, and that would be, like, the cost of a drink.
sentences.zh: 调酒师会捏一小撮你的金砂，这就相当于一杯酒的费用。

sentences.en: So, they would hire the bartenders based on the size of their thumbs.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们会根据拇指的大小来雇用调酒师。

sentences.en: Isn't that amazing?
sentences.zh: 这不是很神奇吗？

sentences.en: Get the biggest pinch possible with your big meat hooks.
sentences.zh: 用你的大肉钩子尽可能捏出最大的一撮。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So, in all, between 1848 and 1855, 300,000 people travel to California.
sentences.zh: 所以，总的来说，在1848年到1855年间，有30万人前往加利福尼亚。

sentences.en: And so, like, the idea of people who normally make $6 in a month, all of a sudden making $75 in a day, what does that do to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此，原本一个月赚6美元的人，突然一天能赚75美元，这对美国...

sentences.en: economy?
sentences.zh: 经济意味着什么？

sentences.en: It revolutionizes the economy.
sentences.zh: 它彻底变革了经济。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So, at this point, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以，当时美国...

sentences.en: has relied on gold and silver to stabilize the economy.
sentences.zh: 一直依靠黄金和白银来稳定经济。

sentences.en: But we basically have no great source of gold before it's found in the California hills.
sentences.zh: 但在加州群山中发现黄金之前，我们基本上没有什么绝佳的黄金来源。

sentences.en: So, the supply of money just shoots up.
sentences.zh: 因此，货币供应量急剧飙升。

sentences.en: And whole industries crop up around it.
sentences.zh: 整个行业也围绕它应运而生。

sentences.en: So, this is, like, so, this is, like, a massive uptick in industrial production.
sentences.zh: 所以，这意味着，工业生产出现了巨大的增长。

sentences.en: The railroad building kicks into high gear.
sentences.zh: 铁路建设进入了全盛期。

sentences.en: The banks and, like, financial institutions just multiply.
sentences.zh: 银行和金融机构如雨后春笋般倍增。

sentences.en: Basically, all of this stuff goes up in response to supporting the gold rush, but also just because people have money.
sentences.zh: 基本上，所有这一切的兴起都是为了支持淘金热，但也纯粹是因为人们有钱了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: There's money in the banks to loan out.
sentences.zh: 银行里有钱可以贷出去了。

sentences.en: There's money in people's pockets to pay for things.
sentences.zh: 人们的口袋里有钱用来支付各种费用了。

sentences.en: So, things just are birthed in response to it.
sentences.zh: 因此，事物随之应运而生。

sentences.en: And the fastest way that that gold gets back to the East Coast, because the East Coast is still the banking capital.
sentences.zh: 黄金运回东海岸的最快方式，因为东海岸依然是银行业中心。

sentences.en: You know, New York is still where the big banks are.
sentences.zh: 你知道，纽约依然是大银行聚集的地方。

sentences.en: The fastest way for that gold to get back East is via steamship.
sentences.zh: 黄金运回东部的最快方式是通过汽船。

sentences.en: So, every two weeks, a steamer would carry tons of commercial gold from San Francisco down to Panama, like we talked about, crossover, and then back to New York City.
sentences.zh: 因此，每两周就会有一艘轮船载着数吨商业黄金从旧金山运往巴拿马，就像我们讨论过的那样，穿过去，然后运回纽约市。

sentences.en: But the thing about this huge influx of gold is that no one is really keeping a lid on how it's affecting the economy.
sentences.zh: 但关于这股巨大的黄金涌入，问题在于没有人真正控制它对经济的影响。

sentences.en: Because at the time, the banking system in the 1850s is incredibly unstable.
sentences.zh: 因为在当时，1850年代的银行体系极其不稳定。

sentences.en: So, Andrew Jackson had killed the central bank at this point.
sentences.zh: 所以，安德鲁·杰克逊当时已经废除了中央银行。

sentences.en: There's no federal regulation of banks.
sentences.zh: 没有对银行的联邦监管。

sentences.en: There's no, like, setting of interest rates to stave off recessions or depressions.
sentences.zh: 也没有设定利率来避免经济衰退或萧条之类的措施。

sentences.en: And so, by 1857, you know, the year of our steamer, the gold rush is kind of winding down.
sentences.zh: 因此，到了1857年，也就是我们的轮船出事的年份，淘金热已经接近尾声。

sentences.en: And that summer, investors are worried that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那年夏天，投资者担心美国...

sentences.en: economy might be overheated and overly reliant on this gold rush bounty that has stopped coming.
sentences.zh: 经济可能已经过热，并且过度依赖这笔已经停止到账的淘金热红利。

sentences.en: So, at this point,
sentences.zh: 所以，在这个时候，

sentences.en: banks are sort of independent institutions where you can go in and put your gold in the bank and they'll give you these banknotes that represent the gold in the bank.
sentences.zh: 银行基本上是独立的机构，你可以把黄金存进银行，他们会给你这些代表银行内黄金的纸币。

sentences.en: But the problem is the banks don't have enough gold in their coffers to give people back the money that they've given them.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，银行金库里没有足够的黄金来兑付他们发给人们的钱。

sentences.en: So, people are coming in with their banknotes trying to get their gold back and there's not enough there.
sentences.zh: 所以，人们拿着纸币来试图取回黄金，但里面的黄金根本不够。

sentences.en: So, they're really dependent on these steady influxes of actual gold from California coming in these steamships.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们非常依赖这些定期从加利福尼亚乘汽船运来的源源不断的实物黄金。

sentences.en: It's getting less and less.
sentences.zh: 这种情况越来越少。

sentences.en: And so, each one matters more and more.
sentences.zh: 因此，每一船黄金都变得愈发重要。

sentences.en: So, this takes us to the steamer that we met at the very beginning of the story, the one that does not make it to New York.
sentences.zh: 这就把我们带到了我们在故事开头遇到的那艘汽船，那艘没能到达纽约的船。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, that steamer has left the San Francisco port.
sentences.zh: 那艘汽船已经离开旧金山港。

sentences.en: It has made its way to Panama.
sentences.zh: 它已经驶抵巴拿马。

sentences.en: The passengers and their gold have crossed over and they have boarded another ship.
sentences.zh: 乘客和他们的黄金已经过境，并登上了另一艘船。

sentences.en: This ship is called the SS Central America.
sentences.zh: 这艘船名叫“中美洲”号（SS Central America）。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And this ship has been a workhorse of the gold rush.
sentences.zh: 这艘船一直是淘金热中的主力军。

sentences.en: So, it has been ferrying a third of all gold on this route since like 1852.
sentences.zh: 因此，自1852年左右以来，它一直在运送这条航线上三分之一的黄金。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: It's a big steam engine.
sentences.zh: 这是一台大型蒸汽机。

sentences.en: So, like you can imagine, there are like wheels on the side that are actually pushing the ship forward.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以想象，船侧面有实际推动船前进的明轮。

sentences.en: So, it's powered by like coal furnaces that are creating steam and then the actual wheels are pushing the boat forward.
sentences.zh: 所以它是靠燃煤炉产生蒸汽来提供动力，然后由实际的轮子推动船只前进。

sentences.en: And on this particular voyage, we have around 500 passengers, 100 crew, and as we said, just a huge amount of gold.
sentences.zh: 在这次特定的航行中，我们大约有500名乘客、100名船员，正如我们所说，还有数量惊人的黄金。

sentences.en: So, they stop in Cuba for a night and then they take off the next morning for New York City.
sentences.zh: 他们在古巴停留了一晚，然后于第二天清晨启程前往纽约市。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And for many passengers, this is the last leg of an extremely long journey home.
sentences.zh: 对许多乘客来说，这是极其漫长回家之旅的最后一段路程。

sentences.en: So, like they were away for years.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们就像离开了很多年一样。

sentences.en: They left their families behind to make enough of a fortune that they could live on for the rest of their lives.
sentences.zh: 他们抛下家人，去赚取足够下半生生活的财富。

sentences.en: Now, they are getting back to New York.
sentences.zh: 现在，他们正在返回纽约。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Things couldn't be more exciting.
sentences.zh: 心情无比激动。

sentences.en: Like they're hyped.
sentences.zh: 他们兴奋极了。

sentences.en: It's so exciting.
sentences.zh: 太令人兴奋了。

sentences.en: And we have these really incredible accounts from what it was actually like on the ship.
sentences.zh: 我们有关于船上实际情况的令人惊叹的真实记述。

sentences.en: So, that first night out from Havana, the newlyweds we talked about, Ansel and Addie Easton, are sitting in the dining saloon next to the captain.
sentences.zh: 因此，离开哈瓦那的第一晚，我们讨论过的那对新婚夫妇安塞尔和阿迪·伊斯顿，正坐在船长旁边的餐厅里。

sentences.en: The captain is this guy named William Herndon.
sentences.zh: 船长是一个名叫威廉·赫恩登的家伙。

sentences.en: He has spent 29 years at sea.
sentences.zh: 他在海上度过了29年。

sentences.en: He is like an absolute pro.
sentences.zh: 他绝对是个专家。

sentences.en: Apparently, he looks more like a professor than a sea captain.
sentences.zh: 显然，他看起来更像个教授，而不像个船长。

sentences.en: He tells these incredible stories of being at sea.
sentences.zh: 他讲述了许多在海上经历的不可思议的故事。

sentences.en: And the conversation turns to shipwrecks because there was this scandal three years earlier where a ship was going down and the captain and the crew saved themselves first and let the rest of the passengers die.
sentences.zh: 谈话转到了海难上，因为三年前曾发生过一起丑闻：一艘船正在沉没，而船长和船员却首先自救，让其余的乘客去死。

sentences.en: Terrible.
sentences.zh: 太可怕了。

sentences.en: And apparently, Herndon says, the captain says, I'll never survive my ship.
sentences.zh: 显然，赫恩登说，船长说，我绝不会在我的船难时独活。

sentences.en: If she goes down, I'll go under her keel.
sentences.zh: 如果她沉没，我将随她的龙骨一同下沉。

sentences.en: But let us talk of something more cheerful.
sentences.zh: 但我们还是聊点更高兴的事吧。

sentences.en: They play cards.
sentences.zh: 他们打牌。

sentences.en: They drink claret.
sentences.zh: 他们喝克莱雷红酒。

sentences.en: They smoke Cuban cigars they just got in Havana.
sentences.zh: 他们抽刚在哈瓦那买的古巴雪茄。

sentences.en: Everyone stays up late until they excuse themselves and go to bed.
sentences.zh: 每个人都熬得很晚，直到各自告辞去睡觉。

sentences.en: And around midnight that night, the wind starts to pick up.
sentences.zh: 那天午夜左右，风开始刮起来了。

sentences.en: Oh, no.
sentences.zh: 噢，不。

sentences.en: It blows hard through the night.
sentences.zh: 整夜狂风大作。

sentences.en: The next afternoon, there's an even more dramatic change.
sentences.zh: 第二天下午，情况发生了更戏剧性的变化。

sentences.en: One of the passengers describes that the waves are turning into mountains.
sentences.zh: 一位乘客形容海浪正在变成大山。

sentences.en: And it's making the ship's bow rise and fall in these dramatic motions.
sentences.zh: 这使得船头以戏剧性的动作上下起伏。

sentences.en: And more immediate than the fear of the storm is seasickness.
sentences.zh: 比对风暴的恐惧更迫在眉睫的是晕船。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So now everybody is sick.
sentences.zh: 所以现在所有人都病倒了。

sentences.en: The ship doctor takes sick, apparently.
sentences.zh: 显然，船医也病倒了。

sentences.en: And the dining saloon is completely deserted.
sentences.zh: 餐厅里空无一人。

sentences.en: There's just a few passengers in there who apparently are eating with their legs wide, bracing themselves, with their elbows pinning to their plates to keep their plates down.
sentences.zh: 里面只有少数乘客，显然他们双腿分得很开以保持平衡，手肘死死撑在盘子上以防盘子滑落。

sentences.en: That's amazing.
sentences.zh: 太惊人了。

sentences.en: The storm grows and grows over the next two days.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的两天里，风暴愈演愈烈。

sentences.en: And then the ship's engineer discovers that the ship has sprung a leak.
sentences.zh: 然后，轮船的轮机长发现船体漏水了。

sentences.en: Oh, no.
sentences.zh: 噢，不。

sentences.en: That's the last thing you want right now.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是你现在最不想遇到的事。

sentences.en: It's the last thing you want right now.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是你现在最不想遇到的事。

sentences.en: The crew finds that there's basically too much water in the bilge, the part of the ship that, like, gathers excess water and pumps it out.
sentences.zh: 船员发现舱底的水实在太多了，舱底是用来收集多余水分并将其抽出的船舱区域。

sentences.en: They search the hold.
sentences.zh: 他们搜查了船舱。

sentences.en: They find the leak.
sentences.zh: 他们找到了漏水点。

sentences.en: It's on the starboard side, the right side of the ship.
sentences.zh: 它在右舷，也就是船的右侧。

sentences.en: And so they stuff it with, like, blankets and old sails.
sentences.zh: 于是他们用毯子和旧船帆之类的东西把它塞住。

sentences.en: They're just trying to stop the leak.
sentences.zh: 他们只是想堵住漏水点。

sentences.en: But every time the ship turns to the right, the water pushes out the sails.
sentences.zh: 但每当船向右转时，水就会把船帆冲出来。

sentences.en: So they push it back in.
sentences.zh: 于是他们把帆塞回去。

sentences.en: The water pushes it out.
sentences.zh: 水又把它冲出来。

sentences.en: But the leak is not their only problem.
sentences.zh: 但漏水并不是他们唯一的麻烦。

sentences.en: The problem with these steamships is that they're anchored in the water by the weight of the coal in the ship.
sentences.zh: 这些汽船的问题在于，它们是靠船内煤炭的重量固定在水里的。

sentences.en: So the coal is actually acting as ballaSt.
sentences.zh: 所以煤炭实际上起到了压舱物的作用。

sentences.en: It's weighing the ship down in the water so that those wheels on the side are getting traction in the water.
sentences.zh: 它把船压在水里，这样船侧面的明轮才能在水里抓地前进。

sentences.en: But they've been fighting a headwind and the sea for days.
sentences.zh: 但他们已经与逆风和大海搏斗了好几天。

sentences.en: So they're burning coal at a rate that they were not planning to burn the coal.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们消耗煤炭的速度超出了原计划的耗煤速度。

sentences.en: So the ship is getting lighter and lighter.
sentences.zh: 所以船变得越来越轻。

sentences.en: It's riding higher in the water, which means they have less purchase with the wheels of the steamship.
sentences.zh: 它在水面上浮得更高，这意味着汽船轮子的抓地力减弱了。

sentences.en: And they just have less control of the ship.
sentences.zh: 他们对船的控制力也随之下降。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So it's being pushed off course.
sentences.zh: 所以它被吹离了航线。

sentences.en: It's heaving to the right at all times, which means that leak is just pouring water into the bilge.
sentences.zh: 它一直向右倾斜，这意味着漏水正不断涌入舱底。

sentences.en: The pumps are running, but the water is rising faster than the pumps can pump it out.
sentences.zh: 水泵一直在运转，但水上涨的速度比水泵抽水的速度还要快。

sentences.en: And the danger here is if the water reaches the furnaces, everything falls apart.
sentences.zh: 这里的危险在于，如果水漫到炉火，一切就都完了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So the water will cool the fires, the steam will drop, and the engines stop.
sentences.zh: 所以水会冷却炉火，蒸汽压力会下降，发动机就会停止运转。

sentences.en: Oh, that is terrifying.
sentences.zh: 哦，那太可怕了。

sentences.en: So they're in this vicious cycle.
sentences.zh: 所以他们陷入了这样一个恶性循环。

sentences.en: They have to burn more coal to keep the ship going in the direction they want.
sentences.zh: 他们必须燃烧更多的煤来让船朝着他们想要的方向行驶。

sentences.en: But the more coal they burn, the lighter the ship gets and less control they have over it.
sentences.zh: 但他们烧的煤越多，船就越轻，他们对船的控制力就越弱。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: This is a nightmare.
sentences.zh: 这是一场噩梦。

sentences.en: It's a total nightmare.
sentences.zh: 这完全是一场噩梦。

sentences.en: And it's a nightmare lasting days.
sentences.zh: 而且这是一场持续数天的噩梦。

sentences.en: Days.
sentences.zh: 数天。

sentences.en: I don't know if most people, I certainly don't, picture a sinking ship lasting days and days.
sentences.zh: 我不知道大多数人——我当然不会——会把沉船想象成持续整整好几天的过程。

sentences.en: When you say a thing like, the seas are so rough, people don't eat.
sentences.zh: 当你提到海况如此恶劣、人们无法进食这种事时。

sentences.en: You're like, oh, who cares?
sentences.zh: 你会想，噢，谁在乎呢？

sentences.en: I can skip a moment.
sentences.zh: 我可以少吃一顿。

sentences.en: But it's three days.
sentences.zh: 但这是三天。

sentences.en: It's three days of puking.
sentences.zh: 这是整整三天的呕吐。

sentences.en: And then you're fighting this thing.
sentences.zh: 然后你还得跟这困境搏斗。

sentences.en: And it isn't just like you have to stave it off for a couple hours while the storm blows over.
sentences.zh: 而且这不仅仅是风暴刮过时你得撑过区区几个小时的问题。

sentences.en: This is days of storm that's happening.
sentences.zh: 这是一个风暴肆虐的年代。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And people getting more and more resigned to the fact that this is going one direction and it's not going the way that they want it to.
sentences.zh: 人们越来越无奈地接受一个事实：局势正在朝着一个方向发展，而这并不是他们所希望的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And that is a different kind of nightmare scenario.
sentences.zh: 而那是另一种令人噩梦般的场景。

sentences.en: It's horrific.
sentences.zh: 太可怕了。

sentences.en: So noon on Friday, it happens.
sentences.zh: 所以，在周五中午，灾难降临了。

sentences.en: They lose the battle.
sentences.zh: 他们战败了。

sentences.en: Water overflows the coal.
sentences.zh: 海水漫过了燃煤。

sentences.en: You can hear it hiss when it hits the furnace.
sentences.zh: 你能听到它撞击炉火时发出的嘶嘶声。

sentences.en: And the hold fills with steam.
sentences.zh: 货舱里充满了蒸汽。

sentences.en: The captain comes in, Herndon, to make an announcement.
sentences.zh: 船长赫恩登走进来宣布消息。

sentences.en: He says, the ship has been leaking for hours.
sentences.zh: 他说，船已经漏水好几个小时了。

sentences.en: There are eight to ten feet of water in the hold.
sentences.zh: 货舱里的水已经有八到十英尺深了。

sentences.en: And now we're going to bail the ship out, bucket by bucket.
sentences.zh: 现在我们要一桶一桶地把水舀出去。

sentences.en: So all men follow me.
sentences.zh: 所以所有人都跟着我。

sentences.en: We are creating bailing lines.
sentences.zh: 我们正在组建排水队。

sentences.en: Because the pumps aren't working fast enough, we're going to do it by hand.
sentences.zh: 因为水泵工作不够快，我们要用人工来干。

sentences.en: In a bailing line, this is like a line of people with buckets.
sentences.zh: 所谓的排水队，就像是一排拿着水桶的人。

sentences.en: And they pass the bucket along.
sentences.zh: 他们把水桶一个接一个地传下去。

sentences.en: And just one bucket at a time, they try to empty that bilthole.
sentences.zh: 他们试图一次只用一个水桶来排空那个舱底。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: They're described as like 500 men in these long lines coiling through the ship up every gangway.
sentences.zh: 据描述，大约有500人排成长长的队伍，蜿蜒穿过船舱，通往每一个通道。

sentences.en: And basically like the arms of like a centipede's legs just passing these buckets.
sentences.zh: 基本上就像蜈蚣的长腿一样，把这些水桶传递着。

sentences.en: But the ship is heaving.
sentences.zh: 但船在剧烈颠簸。

sentences.en: And men are slamming into each other.
sentences.zh: 人们撞击在一起。

sentences.en: The buckets are slipping and spilling.
sentences.zh: 水桶滑落并洒出水来。

sentences.en: The waves are crashing over the side of the ship.
sentences.zh: 巨浪猛烈拍打着船舷。

sentences.en: So they do it all night.
sentences.zh: 所以他们整晚都在这样做。

sentences.en: This is like terribly grueling work.
sentences.zh: 这简直是极度折磨人的苦差事。

sentences.en: They're not eating.
sentences.zh: 他们顾不上吃饭。

sentences.en: And at some point, Addy Easton takes their like newlywed baskets and starts feeding the men and giving them wine.
sentences.zh: 在某个时刻，阿迪·伊斯顿拿出他们新婚时带来的篮子，开始喂船员们吃东西并给他们酒喝。

sentences.en: And the women are trying to help.
sentences.zh: 女人们试图帮忙。

sentences.en: They won't let them.
sentences.zh: 但他们不让。

sentences.en: But everyone knows that this is really their only chance.
sentences.zh: 不过大家都知道，这确实是他们唯一的希望了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So at some point, the captain acknowledges that the ship is going down, that basically we are just trying to stave it off so that we can get rescued.
sentences.zh: 所以在某个时刻，船长承认船正在下沉，基本上我们现在这么做只是为了苦苦支撑，好等待救援。

sentences.en: And the fact that you're telling me any of this detail means that some people did survive, like there was some kind of rescue.
sentences.zh: 你既然能告诉我这些细节，说明确实有人幸存下来了，比如有某种救援。

sentences.en: What ended up happening?
sentences.zh: 后来究竟发生了什么？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So around 2 p.m.
sentences.zh: 大约在下午两点

sentences.en: after like 24 hours of bailing the ship, there's a miracle.
sentences.zh: 在连续舀了24小时的水之后，奇迹发生了。

sentences.en: Somebody sees another ship on the horizon, shouts, sail ho, and that ship makes its way to them.
sentences.zh: 有人看到地平线上出现另一艘船，大喊“发现帆船”，那艘船朝他们驶来。

sentences.en: It's also been battered in the storm.
sentences.zh: 它也在风暴中饱受摧残。

sentences.en: It's called the Marine.
sentences.zh: 它叫“海洋号”。

sentences.en: It's been carrying molasses from Cuba up to Boston.
sentences.zh: 它一直运载着古巴的糖蜜前往波士顿。

sentences.en: It finally gets to the ship and it gets close enough that the captain is able to yell over to the other ship, which is basically like, we are in sinking condition.
sentences.zh: 它终于驶近这艘船，距离近得让船长能够冲另一艘船大喊，大意是：我们正在下沉。

sentences.en: Can you stay close by me until morning?
sentences.zh: 你能陪在我附近直到早晨吗？

sentences.en: And he promises to try and stay as close as possible.
sentences.zh: 对方承诺会尽量靠得最近。

sentences.en: But there are a few problems with this rescue plan.
sentences.zh: 但这个救援计划有几个问题。

sentences.en: There's more probleMs.
sentences.zh: 还有更多问题。

sentences.en: As you can imagine.
sentences.zh: 正如你所想象的那样。

sentences.en: So at this point, there are only three lifeboats left.
sentences.zh: 所以此时此刻，只剩下三艘救生艇了。

sentences.en: The lifeboats have been flying off of the ship because it's been a hurricane.
sentences.zh: 救生艇之前都被飓风刮飞了。

sentences.en: And then there's all the gold.
sentences.zh: 然后还有所有的黄金。

sentences.en: Oh, the gold.
sentences.zh: 哦，黄金。

sentences.en: I almost forgot about the gold.
sentences.zh: 我差点把黄金这事给忘了。

sentences.en: Did you really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, this is like I'm more concerned about the human tragedy that's unfolding.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道的，我当时更关心的是正在上演的人间悲剧。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: But what is going on with the gold?
sentences.zh: 但黄金到底怎么回事？

sentences.en: I mean, that's the whole reason why this boat kind of exists.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这正是这艘船存在的全部意义。

sentences.en: Is to ferry that gold.
sentences.zh: 就是为了运送那些黄金。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: So this is the question.
sentences.zh: 所以问题就在这里。

sentences.en: At this point, people realize ship's going down.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，人们意识到船要沉了。

sentences.en: How much gold can I take with me?
sentences.zh: 我能带走多少黄金？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Do I take the gold?
sentences.zh: 我是把黄金带走？

sentences.en: Do I leave it behind?
sentences.zh: 还是把它留在船上？

sentences.en: Most of the passengers are these returning miners.
sentences.zh: 大部分乘客都是这些返程的矿工。

sentences.en: You know, they've tried to accumulate at least a few thousand dollars.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们千方百计积攒了至少几千美元。

sentences.en: And this is all they have.
sentences.zh: 而这就是他们的全部身家。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They've been carrying it on their bodies.
sentences.zh: 他们一直把黄金绑在身上。

sentences.en: They've suffered so much to get this gold.
sentences.zh: 他们历经千辛万苦才弄到这些黄金。

sentences.en: But it's heavy.
sentences.zh: 但它们太重了。

sentences.en: You know, we talked about it.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们讨论过。

sentences.en: It's like it is heavier than you can imagine.
sentences.zh: 这东西比你能想象的还要重。

sentences.en: These money belts are 10 pounds, 50 pounds, 100 pounds.
sentences.zh: 这些钱袋重达10磅、50磅、100磅。

sentences.en: And they're advised to only carry two $20 gold pieces with them off of the ship.
sentences.zh: 他们被建议离船时每人只带两枚20美元的金币。

sentences.en: And at this point, the captain's only letting women and children into the lifeboats.
sentences.zh: 而此时，船长只允许妇女和儿童登上救生艇。

sentences.en: So if you're a miner and you have 100 pounds of gold, you're basically deciding, am I going into the water with this 100 pounds of gold?
sentences.zh: 所以如果你是一个矿工，手里有100磅黄金，你基本上得决定：我要带着这100磅黄金跳进水里吗？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对吧。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because you're going to drown.
sentences.zh: 因为你会淹死的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's yeah, you are going to be swimming with 50 pounds of gold and you're not going to make it a couple of miles with 50 pounds of gold.
sentences.zh: 你会背着50磅黄金在水里游，而背着50磅黄金你根本游不了几英里。

sentences.en: And after, you know, hoarding this gold, protecting it, keeping it safe to their bodies,
sentences.zh: 在你知道囤积了这些黄金、保护它、紧贴着身体确保安全之后，

sentences.en: it's fascinating what people do in response to this information that they can't take it with them.
sentences.zh: 人们在听到无法带走黄金这一消息后的反应真是令人着迷。

sentences.en: They just start spraying the gold into the oncoming waves.
sentences.zh: 他们开始把黄金像撒水一样抛向迎面而来的巨浪中。

sentences.en: Like throwing it.
sentences.zh: 就像往下扔一样。

sentences.en: Throwing it.
sentences.zh: 拼命扔。

sentences.en: There are these images of like women shaking $11,000 of gold onto the floor, weeping.
sentences.zh: 有这样一些画面：女人们把价值11000美元的黄金倒在地板上，痛哭流涕。

sentences.en: You know, $11,000 in 1857 is $400,000 today.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，1857年的11000美元相当于今天的40万美元。

sentences.en: Can you imagine just like shaking $400,000 onto the floor, knowing that like if you survive, you will be penniless?
sentences.zh: 你能想象把40万美元倒在地板上，明知如果生还自己将一无所有吗？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: One man apparently ripped open a bag of gold dust and just like sprayed it into the air like fairy duSt.
sentences.zh: 据说有个男人撕开了一袋金砂，像仙女撒粉一样把它撒进空气中。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I just think it's such an interesting instinct of like, I cannot have it anymore and I want to just like experience its abundance.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得这是一种非常有趣的本能：我既然不能再拥有它了，我就只想体验一下它那种丰盛的感觉。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 说真的。

sentences.en: What do you think it is?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这是为什么？

sentences.en: That feels resonant to me.
sentences.zh: 我对此很有共鸣。

sentences.en: The other part is that they've gone through so much effort for this gold at this point.
sentences.zh: 另一个原因是，他们为了这些黄金付出了太多的心血。

sentences.en: There has to be some kind of ceremony to it.
sentences.zh: 这必须带有一种仪式感。

sentences.en: It's like it leaving you.
sentences.zh: 就像它在离你而去一样。

sentences.en: Like you can't just sink.
sentences.zh: 你不能只是让它沉下去。

sentences.en: It can't just be in a corner in a little trunk and just go down.
sentences.zh: 它不能只是静静地待在小皮箱的角落里然后下沉。

sentences.en: Like you have to acknowledge, like there's a catalog of it.
sentences.zh: 你必须承认它的存在，比如给它盘点一下。

sentences.en: You have to acknowledge it.
sentences.zh: 你必须正视它。

sentences.en: And then it can go down.
sentences.zh: 然后它才能沉没。

sentences.en: Like they're letting go of a dream or a life or a life that was maybe theirs to come but is not going to happen anymore.
sentences.zh: 就像他们在放下一个梦想、一种生活，或者一种本来可能属于他们但再也不会实现的生活。

sentences.en: So they are actually able to save more than a hundred passengers.
sentences.zh: 最终他们实际上成功拯救了一百多名乘客。

sentences.en: All of the women and children make it off the ship and some men.
sentences.zh: 所有的妇女和儿童都逃离了这艘船，还有一些男人。

sentences.en: Addie gets off the ship but Ansel doesn't.
sentences.zh: 阿迪成功逃生，但安塞尔没有。

sentences.en: And everyone else ends up in the water.
sentences.zh: 而其他所有人都落入了水中。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Ansel describes these like the last moments on the ship.
sentences.zh: 安塞尔描述了船上的这些最后时刻。

sentences.en: He's on the hurricane deck next to Captain Herndon and a few other men.
sentences.zh: 他在飓风甲板上，挨着赫恩登船长和其他几个人。

sentences.en: They're just watching the storm.
sentences.zh: 他们只是在看着风暴。

sentences.en: And one final wave engulfs the ship.
sentences.zh: 一个最后的大浪吞没了这艘船。

sentences.en: And he gets pulled into a whirlpool.
sentences.zh: 他被卷入了一个漩涡中。

sentences.en: I didn't know this but as a ship goes down it creates this vortex in the water that pulls you down.
sentences.zh: 我以前不知道这一点，但当船下沉时，它会在水中产生一个把你往下拽的漩涡。

sentences.en: Ansel is pulled into the whirlpool.
sentences.zh: 安塞尔被卷入了漩涡。

sentences.en: It's chaos.
sentences.zh: 现场一片混乱。

sentences.en: He struggles out of his coat.
sentences.zh: 他挣扎着脱掉了外套。

sentences.en: He somehow surfaces and pops up surrounded by men.
sentences.zh: 他不知怎么浮出水面，冒出头来，周围全是人。

sentences.en: And he gets on some kind of wooden plank.
sentences.zh: 他爬上了一块某种木板。

sentences.en: And he survives.
sentences.zh: 他活了下来。

sentences.en: So another ship shows up.
sentences.zh: 随后又出现了一艘船。

sentences.en: The Ellen sails through the wreckage and picks him up along with 48 other men.
sentences.zh: “埃伦号”穿过残骸，救起了他以及其他48名男子。

sentences.en: There's actually a third boat that then rescues three more men.
sentences.zh: 实际上还有第三艘船，随后又救了另外三名男子。

sentences.en: And that's it.
sentences.zh: 就这些了。

sentences.en: And there's an incredible account of Ansel and Addie reuniting at the end of this.
sentences.zh: 在这一切结束时，有一个关于安塞尔和阿迪重聚的动人故事。

sentences.en: You know not knowing that the other had made it.
sentences.zh: 当时他们都不知道对方是否幸存。

sentences.en: And it's because of Addie's diaries, her memoirs, that we know so much of this detail.
sentences.zh: 正是因为有了阿迪的日记和回忆录，我们才得以了解这么多细节。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Which then journalists like Gary Kinder drew on.
sentences.zh: 后来像加里·金德这样的记者便取材于此。

sentences.en: But Captain Herndon does go down with the ship, true to his word, along with 400 other people.
sentences.zh: 但赫恩登船长信守承诺，与船共存亡，同行的还有其他400人。

sentences.en: It is the worst commercial maritime disaster in the country's history at that point.
sentences.zh: 那是当时该国历史上最严重的商业海难。

sentences.en: So all those souls were loSt.
sentences.zh: 所以那些生命全都消逝了。

sentences.en: Few people were rescued.
sentences.zh: 只有少数人获救。

sentences.en: And this is where the story goes beyond the immediate tragedy of the shipwreck.
sentences.zh: 而这正是故事超越海难即时悲剧的地方。

sentences.en: Because all that gold, that all goes to the bottom of the ocean.
sentences.zh: 因为所有这些黄金，全都沉到了海底。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: All of this gold that the New York banks are waiting for does not make it.
sentences.zh: 纽约各家银行苦苦等待的所有这些黄金，最终没能运到。

sentences.en: And remember, the banks are in bad shape.
sentences.zh: 而且你要记住，当时的银行状况非常糟糕。

sentences.en: They need that gold.
sentences.zh: 它们急需那些黄金。

sentences.en: They're really running on fumes.
sentences.zh: 它们的资金已经彻底见底了。

sentences.en: The railroad stocks are slipping.
sentences.zh: 铁路股票正在下跌。

sentences.en: Land speculation bubble is starting to deflate.
sentences.zh: 土地投机泡沫开始破裂。

sentences.en: They have given out way too many loans that are not going to be repaid.
sentences.zh: 它们发放了太多根本无法偿还的贷款。

sentences.en: And then in August, just a few weeks before the ship goes down, a big financial institution in Ohio collapses.
sentences.zh: 然后在八月，就在船沉没前几周，俄亥俄州的一家大型金融机构倒闭了。

sentences.en: New York investors start pulling their money out of the banks, but there's not enough gold and silver in reserve for them.
sentences.zh: 纽约投资者开始将资金撤出银行，但他们储备的黄金和白银根本不够。

sentences.en: So they're waiting on that gold from the ship.
sentences.zh: 所以他们在等船上运回的黄金。

sentences.en: The ship goes down.
sentences.zh: 船沉了。

sentences.en: The gold doesn't arrive.
sentences.zh: 黄金没有运到。

sentences.en: And the banks can hold on for a few weeks.
sentences.zh: 银行还能勉强支撑几周。

sentences.en: But news of the shipwreck, this like massive loss of life, massive loss of gold, it helps push along the thing that's already happening.
sentences.zh: 但海难的消息，这场巨大的人员伤亡和黄金损失，加速推动了本就在发生的事情。

sentences.en: And a few weeks after, there's a run on the banks in New York.
sentences.zh: 几周后，纽约出现了挤兑潮。

sentences.en: And then the banks stop altogether paying out the gold.
sentences.zh: 接着，银行彻底停止支付黄金。

sentences.en: A huge panic follows.
sentences.zh: 随之而来的是巨大的恐慌。

sentences.en: This is called the Panic of 1857.
sentences.zh: 这就是所谓的1857年恐慌。

sentences.en: It goes fast because of the telegraph at this point.
sentences.zh: 由于此时电报的出现，蔓延速度极快。

sentences.en: It's the first global financial panic because we can communicate our fear.
sentences.zh: 这是第一次全球金融恐慌，因为我们能够交流彼此的恐惧。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: And because we can communicate our fear, we are afraid everywhere.
sentences.zh: 正因为我们能够交流恐惧，我们在各地都感到恐慌。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: This is no longer a regional bank not having enough gold.
sentences.zh: 这不再只是一家区域性银行黄金不足的问题。

sentences.en: This is like everyone knows it.
sentences.zh: 而是人人都知道了。

sentences.en: Every banking institution around the world knows it.
sentences.zh: 世界各地的每家银行机构都知道了。

sentences.en: And everyone is trying to get their money out of the bank.
sentences.zh: 每个人都试图把钱从银行取出来。

sentences.en: So the banks get suspended.
sentences.zh: 于是银行暂停营业。

sentences.en: Some of them shut down entirely.
sentences.zh: 其中一些彻底倒闭了。

sentences.en: And the railroads go under.
sentences.zh: 铁路公司也破产了。

sentences.en: Grain prices crater.
sentences.zh: 谷物价格暴跌。

sentences.en: It hits farmers hard.
sentences.zh: 这对农民打击沉重。

sentences.en: Foreclosures everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都是止赎潮。

sentences.en: Land sales are drying up.
sentences.zh: 土地销售停滞不前。

sentences.en: Western expansion basically stops until the panic is over.
sentences.zh: 在恐慌结束之前，向西扩张基本陷入停顿。

sentences.en: And it even makes its way to Europe.
sentences.zh: 它甚至蔓延到了欧洲。

sentences.en: So there are reverberations of this globally.
sentences.zh: 因此这产生了全球性的余波。

sentences.en: But there's another part of the story that is not even about the money that I think is really important.
sentences.zh: 但故事中还有另一个与金钱无关的部分，我认为非常重要。

sentences.en: So this panic hammered the North.
sentences.zh: 所以这场恐慌沉重打击了北方。

sentences.en: It's factories.
sentences.zh: 打击了工厂。

sentences.en: It's banks.
sentences.zh: 打击了银行。

sentences.en: It's railroad.
sentences.zh: 打击了铁路。

sentences.en: But the South barely feels it.
sentences.zh: 但南方几乎毫无感觉。

sentences.en: Part of that's structural.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是结构性的。

sentences.en: There are fewer railroads there, fewer financial institutions.
sentences.zh: 那里的铁路较少，金融机构也较少。

sentences.en: But it's also because of cotton.
sentences.zh: 但这也是因为棉花。

sentences.en: So cotton prices only dip a little bit.
sentences.zh: 所以棉花价格只稍微下跌了一点。

sentences.en: And they recover faSt.
sentences.zh: 而且它们迅速恢复了。

sentences.en: So Southern planters come through the panic of 1857 feeling invincible.
sentences.zh: 因此南方种植园主度过1857年恐慌后，感觉自己不可战胜。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And they feel like the institution of slavery has saved them and has proved to the virtue signaling North that the slave-based economy is better.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得奴隶制挽救了他们，并向虚伪的北方证明了基于奴隶制的经济更好。

sentences.en: And in response to the panic of 1857, we get this very famous speech in the Senate by this guy James Henry Hammond.
sentences.zh: 作为对1857年恐慌的回应，这个名叫詹姆斯·亨利·哈蒙德的家伙在参议院发表了一场著名的演讲。

sentences.en: It's called the Cotton is King speech.

sentences.zh: 但我认为黄金诅咒最有趣的地方在于，黄金总是先给予，后索取。

sentences.en: The promise of the gold is followed by ruin.
sentences.zh: 黄金的承诺之后随之而来的是毁灭。

sentences.en: So, in 1849, like, its promise drives all these men to drop everything and move across the continent.
sentences.zh: 所以，在1849年，它的承诺驱使所有这些男人放下一切，横跨整个大陆。

sentences.en: Some of them find riches, but most of them find, like, deep disappointment.
